description: This Java class defines a custom Hibernate dialect for the H2 database, named 'H2LessStrictDialect', that overrides certain default type mappings in order to address specific behaviors and validation issues encountered with the standard H2Dialect within the OpenMRS project. It adjusts mappings for types like BIGINT, CLOB, FLOAT, TIMESTAMP, UUID (VARCHAR), and long string types.

classes.name: H2LessStrictDialect
classes.description: A custom Hibernate dialect extending H2Dialect to override specific SQL type mappings for better compatibility within the OpenMRS context.

methods.name: H2LessStrictDialect
methods.description: Constructor that registers custom column type mappings for H2 database to resolve specific validation issues.
